# UX, Accessibility & i18n Requirements Checklist: Member Portal — Approval Workflow for Member Changes

**Purpose**: Validate that the UX requirements (screens, states, copy), WCAG 2.1 AA requirements and EN/TH/SV requirements are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before `/speckit.tasks`. Formal gate; `enterprise-ux-designer` + `i18n-translation-reviewer` co-sign at `/speckit.review`.
**Created**: 2026-09-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/) · `docs/ux-standards.md` · `docs/ux-patterns.md`

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit.checklist`. `[x]` = reviewer judged the requirement text satisfactory; not implementation status.

## Requirement Completeness — surfaces & states

- [ ] CHK001 Is every new surface named with its route and owner role — portal edit (gate mode), pending/decision banner, portal history; staff queue, review page, member-record section, settings card; nav item; dashboard item — so nothing is "implied"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034, Plan § Source Code]
- [ ] CHK002 Are loading, empty, error and permission-denied states specified for each surface (e.g. an empty queue, a review page for a withdrawn request, a member with no history), rather than delegated to "the playbook"? [Gap, Spec §FR-034; Panel § Unverified 7] → closed: FR-034
- [ ] CHK003 Is the pending banner's content bounded — proposed vs current values, submission time, withdraw action, "awaiting review" wording — and its placement (profile page and edit page) stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §US1 AS1]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the post-decision state on the portal defined for all three outcomes (approved / partially approved / rejected), including how long it stays visible and how the member dismisses it? [Gap, Spec §FR-010 names the outcomes but not persistence/dismissal] → closed: FR-010 + `outcome_acknowledged_at` / acknowledge route
- [ ] CHK005 Is the resubmit form behaviour fully specified: only rejected values prefilled, approved fields shown live, and whether approved fields may be edited again in the same resubmission? [Ambiguity, Spec §US3 AS3, §FR-023] → closed: FR-023 + US3 AS3
- [ ] CHK006 Is the "nothing to submit" and "already awaiting review" feedback specified as inline, non-blocking messages (not error dialogs), with copy? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §US1 AS3]
- [ ] CHK007 Is a confirmation required for **withdraw** (a destructive-style action on the member's own request), and if not, is the omission deliberate? [Gap, Spec §FR-009; `docs/ux-patterns.md` § 1] → closed: FR-009 (standard confirmation)
- [ ] CHK008 Is the language-setting move (contact email/notification language → account page beside the display language) specified with copy that distinguishes the two settings for a member? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, § Assumptions "Preferred language leaves the change-request form"]

## Requirement Clarity — review & decision interaction

- [ ] CHK009 Is the decision table's interaction fully specified — every row pre-selected, de-select to reject, address groups as one row, "changed since submitted" three-value display, tax-affecting flag — and is the *default* (all approved) stated as a requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §FR-019, Clarifications Q3]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the confirm button's dynamic label defined for all cases ("Approve all N" / "Approve A, reject B" / "Reject all N") with pluralisation rules in EN/TH/SV, so the copy is translatable (ICU plural), not concatenated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the confirmation-dialog requirements aligned with `docs/ux-standards.md` § 6.2/6.4 — focus starts on Cancel, Escape cancels, destructive variant iff any rejection, spinner + stays open, reason required iff any rejection, `finalFocus` back to the confirm control? [Consistency, Spec §FR-034, Research R13]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the reason textarea specified with limit, live counter, required-state announcement and error copy, consistent with the existing broadcast reject dialog? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Research R13]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the concurrency messages defined as user-facing copy — "already decided by X at T", "member archived", "request withdrawn by the member" — rather than raw error codes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, §FR-020, Contract admin §3]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the queue's default order and the > 3-day "overdue" flag specified with a non-colour-only indicator and screen-reader text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]

## Requirement Completeness — accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)

- [ ] CHK015 Are keyboard requirements stated for the decision table (row checkbox labelled with the field name, Space toggles, focus order rows → reason → confirm) and for the diff table on mobile? [Gap, Spec §FR-034 says "WCAG 2.1 AA" only] → closed: FR-034
- [ ] CHK016 Are live-region requirements defined — pending banner `role="status"`, decision outcome announcement, "nothing to submit" message — so state changes are announced? [Completeness, Plan Constitution VI]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the 320 px / mobile layout for the diff and decision tables specified (stacked cards, address group as a block) with no horizontal scroll? [Completeness, Plan Constitution VI, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the tax-affecting flag, outcome badges and the "changed since submitted" marker required to convey meaning by text/icon, not colour alone? [Gap, Spec §FR-019] → closed: FR-034
- [ ] CHK019 Are heading-structure requirements stated (real `<h2>` sections, one `<h1>` per page) for the new portal and staff pages, matching the portal pattern? [Consistency, Plan Constitution VI]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the axe scan at 320 px on every new surface named as an acceptance criterion with a zero-violation target? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]

## Requirement Completeness — i18n (EN / TH / SV)

- [ ] CHK021 Is the key inventory (~70 keys) enumerated by namespace — portal, admin, nav, audit labels (Thai script), timeline, email — so `check:i18n` and the label-coverage test have a defined target? [Completeness, Plan Constitution V, Research R17]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the two email templates required in all three locales with the recipient-locale rule (reviewer's own locale ?? tenant default; contact's `preferred_language`) and a stated fallback when the preference is missing? [Clarity, Contract notifications §1]
- [ ] CHK023 Is it specified that the reviewer's reason is shown **as typed, never translated**, in every locale of the member email and history? [Consistency, Spec § Assumptions "Reasons are plain text", §US3 AS2]
- [ ] CHK024 Are date/time display rules stated — tenant timezone in emails, `formatLocalisedDate` (BE display-only for `th-TH`) on pages, ISO-8601 UTC in APIs? [Consistency, Contract portal "ChangeRequestView", Plan Constitution V]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the outcome vocabulary ("approved" / "partially approved" / "rejected" / "withdrawn" / "replaced") fixed as one glossary used identically in queue, history, badge, email and timeline copy, with a Thai rendering agreed (no italic on Thai)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK026 Are field labels for the Group B keys (incl. address lines and "job title") required to reuse the existing member/contact form labels rather than new strings, to avoid divergence between the edit form, the diff table and the email? [Consistency, Data-model §3]

## Edge Cases

- [ ] CHK027 Is the display defined when a proposed value is a *clear* (null) — "(empty)" wording in all three locales, on page and in email? [Edge Case, Contract notifications §1]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the display defined when the member's status is archived on the queue row and review page (badge + why the decision is disabled)? [Edge Case, Spec § Edge Cases "Member archived while a request is pending"]

## Notes

- CHK002, CHK004, CHK005, CHK007, CHK015 are spec-text gaps; the remainder can be closed in `tasks.md` by naming the component/pattern each requirement reuses.
- 2026-09-11: every item annotated "→ closed:" was resolved the same day in the spec (Clarifications session "gap closure — AMENDMENT", FR-038–FR-040) or in plan.md / contracts / quickstart; checkboxes stay reviewer-owned and are ticked at `/speckit.review`.
